Sejal has a 4-digit door code.
The first digit is an even prime number.
The second digit is a cube number greater than 1.
The third digit is the highest common factor (HCF) of 12 and 8.
The fourth digit is a triangle number between 2 and 5.
Work out the 4-digit code.
first
second
third
fourth
